text: This S1000D technical manual document provides a manual test procedure for bicycle fork systems. It specifies step-by-step instructions for testing fork stability and integrity on Mountain bicycle models (Mountain storm Mk1 or Brook trekker Mk9), requiring approximately 0.1 hours for a basic operator to complete. The procedure includes climbing, steering, riding, and pressure tests to verify proper wheel stability and fork sealing performance.

# S1000D Data Module: Front Wheel Removal Procedure

This is a technical maintenance document specifying step-by-step procedures for removing the front wheel from mountain bicycles (Mountain Storm Mk1 and Brook Trekker Mk9 models). It includes preliminary requirements (specialized tools and lubricants), detailed removal steps with circuit breaker operations, warnings, applicable product variants, and illustrative graphics. The document is issued in English (US), version 005, dated July 2026, under ASD copyright with standard export and liability restrictions.

This S1000D data module documents a common information repository containing a centralized list of warnings for lighting systems. It specifies two reusable warnings—one about ensuring bulbs are cool before replacement and another about checking light glass for damage before handling—that can be referenced across technical documentation. The module is issued in English (US), version 005, dated July 2026, and is publicly distributable under ASD copyright with standard liability disclaimers.
